277128090.description:
Product Overview:
This lot contains a variety of collectible rocks, minerals, and gemstones. Included are tumbled, raw, and polished specimens stored in labeled miniature glass jars. Specimens include Yellow Jade, Garnet, Snowflake Obsidian, Fluorite, Amazonite, Red Crystal, Tiger Quartz, and Agate. Additional loose specimens feature amethyst clusters, pyrite, malachite, fossilized shells, and other colorful minerals and crystals.

Specifications:
- Condition: Used with natural variations
- Weight: Approximately 5 pounds
- Packaging: Some specimens in labeled miniature glass jars
- Types: Tumbled, raw, and polished rocks, minerals, and gemstones

This collection displays a range of colors, shapes, and forms.

276809463.description: This lot includes a variety of rough and polished rock and mineral specimens. It features two large polished halves of petrified wood showing visible ring structures with brown, yellow, and grey tones. Additional items include rough stones such as a quartz crystal cluster, a tan botryoidal chalcedony nodule, and various pieces of petrified wood and agate in both natural and cut forms. Specimens range from uncut rough stones to polished display pieces. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or lapidary projects.

277050508.description: This vintage mid-century pipe smoker's set includes a cork and brass base, a brass lidded tobacco jar showing visible patina and oxidation inside, a wooden and plastic smoking pipe, and two brass pipe rests. The brass components display tarnish and wear consistent with age, and the pipe shows signs of use. The cork base has pads on the underside for stability. The set features classic mid-century modern design elements and visible flaws include patina inside the jar and tarnish on the brass parts.

277583092.description:
Calcite Crystal Cluster
Natural Mineral Specimen, Greyish White
Large Format, Approximately 11.4 Pounds
Substantial natural calcite crystal cluster featuring a dense formation of rhombohedral and scalenohedral crystal points. This impressive specimen exhibits a range of translucent to semi-opaque white and grey tones, typical of high-quality earth-mined calcite. Its large scale and significant weight make it an excellent focal piece for interior decor, mineral collections, or metaphysical display.
Naturally formed crystal cluster with multiple termination points across the surface
Varied tonal palette of soft greys and milky whites with occasional translucent areas
Rugged natural base showing the matrix from which the crystals formed
Substantial 11.4-pound weight with a 13-inch primary axis
Condition:
Very good overall condition with average wear consistent with natural extraction and handling. Surfaces remain structurally sound with the characteristic geometric cleavage planes of calcite well-preserved. Minor surface dust or tiny natural abrasions may be present, common to raw mineral specimens of this size.
